nodes.title: **Key Features**
nodes.summary: Loans from ₹25,000 up to ₹50 lakhs (or local equivalent) with competitive interest, flexible seasonal EMI or bullet repayment, fast-tracked disbursement, no prepayment penalty, secured or partially secured collateral options, and an extra 1% interest rate discount for women-led agri ventures.

nodes.title: **Who Can Apply?**
nodes.summary: Eligible applicants include individual farmers, joint landholders, Self Help Groups (SHGs), and agribusinesses and cooperatives.

nodes.title: **Documents Required**
nodes.summary: Application needs proof of identity (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport), address proof, land ownership or lease documents, recent passport-size photographs, an optional Kisan Credit Card, and equipment quotations or invoices where applicable.

nodes.title: **How to Apply?**
nodes.summary: Apply online via the ZX Bank Asia app (Loans > Agriculture Loan) with Zia AI assistance, at a branch or digital kiosk with dedicated Agri-Loan officers, or by phone/email through customer care.

children.title: **1. Online Application (Recommended)**
children.summary: Download the ZX Bank Asia app, login with mobile number and e-KYC, go to Loans > Agriculture Loan, fill the form and upload documents, track application status in real time, and use the Zia AI assistant for help.

children.title: **2. Visit a Branch or Digital Kiosk**
children.summary: Visit a ZX Bank branch or digital banking kiosk, collect and fill the Agriculture Loan application form, submit documents for verification, and get support from dedicated Agri-Loan officers.

children.title: **3. Contact Customer Care**
children.summary: Call the Agri Loan helpline at toll-free 1800-123-4567 or email support at agrihelp@zxbank.asia.

nodes.title: **ZX Bank Supporting Rural Dreams**
nodes.summary: ZX Bank partners with local agri-input suppliers and markets for seamless credit, and provides exclusive SMS alerts, agri-weather tips, and crop advisory with every loan; applications are linked at zxbank.asia/agri-loans.
